description: TOP-UP. Ex-BWIA International flagship; maiden flight 30 July 1980 and delivered 14 August 1980; retired March 2001 with over 60000 flight hours; stood abandoned at Piarco for three years then cut up in April 2004 and moved to the museum; reassembled MISSING ONE WING because the museum site could not take the full span and arrived with two engines of which one was to be mounted and one opened up as a cut-away; the fuselage was rewired and air-conditioned so visitors can walk through it and sit in the cockpit; year_built 1980 from the sourced first-flight date not from the registration
museum_name: Chaguaramas Military History and Aerospace Museum
